A 28 cm HydroJet roller with 24 water ports spins at 270 RPM, nine times a second, cleaning itself continuously while it mops. A built-in scraper moves dirt into a separate tank so the roller stays clean and marks from paw prints and spills disappear.
The DuoSpiral brush handles hair up to 30 cm (11.8 in) long without wrapping it around the roller, which suits homes with several pets. No more cutting hair off a clogged brush by hand.
Lifts pet hair, dander, kibble crumbs and fine dust from carpets and hard floors, with suction boosted automatically on carpet.
The all-in-one station empties dust into a 3 L bag, washes the mop, dries it with 50°C hot air to prevent mould and collects the wastewater. It handles 95% of maintenance for up to 75 days.

LiDAR navigation avoids obstacles of 3 × 3 × 3 cm and larger, such as furniture, toys and pet bowls, without using any camera. The mop lifts 10.8 mm on short carpet, the long-lasting battery covers several rooms and operation measures 54.89 dB.

Hair-tangling figures come from internal testing. On hard floors and Wilton carpet, a mix of 0.15 g of 20 cm hair and 0.15 g of 30 cm hair left no hair on the roller brush over 7 consecutive cleaning cycles, and 1 g of 8 to 15 cm Golden Retriever hair left none after 6 consecutive cycles.
